description.en: Profile bundles published by the Veren project: startup autostart, Sub2API operations, the application framework, Person Agent, forum, notebook, admin console, Web login gate, CMS bridge, and session fork.
description.zh: Veren 项目发布的 profile 组合包：启动自启动、Sub2API 运营、应用框架、管家 Person Agent、论坛、笔记本、管理台、Web 登录门禁、CMS 桥接与会话分叉。

description.en: Runs work at every DSH start: a resident host service, model-facing tools for adding and changing startup items, the matching guidance skill, and the Web UI, installed as one profile layer.
description.zh: 让任务在每次 DSH 启动时自动执行：常驻的宿主服务、供模型增删改启动项的工具、配套的使用指南和 Web 界面，一次装齐。

description.en: Runs a Sub2API instance from DSH: an ops-console home page plus channels, groups, users, subscriptions, finance, redeem/promo codes, accounts, and usage pages, with eleven model-facing admin tools sharing one credential config.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里运营 Sub2API 实例：指挥台首页加渠道、分组、用户、订阅、资金、卡密、账号、用量九个页面，配十一个共凭据的管理工具。装好后按插件 README 配置 baseUrl 与管理员凭据即可用。

description.en: Installs the whole Veren application framework in one step: a configuration-only bundle that inserts the app registry, page registry, and task center plus the app-host assembly row in dependency order, so app plugins work without manual cross-service wiring.
description.zh: 一步装齐 Veren 应用框架：纯配置组合包，按依赖顺序插入应用注册表、页面注册表、任务中心三个宿主服务和 app-host 装配行，应用插件无需手工跨服务接线。

description.en: An assistant that works as your personal agent: a delegating bridge persona exposed as an application, with a workbench overview (workspaces, presets, models), page-scoped session and workspace maintenance tools, and a writing skill — all inside the app's page sessions.
description.zh: 以管家身份工作的助手：把派活桥梁人格暴露为一个应用，带工作台概览（工作区/预设/模型）、页面级会话与工作区维护工具和写作技能——全部活在应用的页面会话里。

description.en: Discussion inside DSH: a durable forum service with model-facing post and comment tools, plus the Web page people read and reply on.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里发起讨论：持久化的论坛服务和供模型读写帖子、评论的工具，外加供人浏览和回复的 Web 页面。

description.en: Private notes inside DSH: a durable notebook service with model-facing note tools, plus the Web page where a person reads and edits them.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里保存私人笔记：持久化的笔记本服务和供模型读写笔记的工具，外加供人查看和编辑的 Web 页面。

description.en: Turns a DSH profile into a general AI admin console: kernel, gateway, data, authentication, access control, navigation, audit, docs, and the default UI, installed as one profile layer.
description.zh: 把 DSH profile 变成通用的 AI 管理后台：内核、网关、数据层、认证、权限、导航、审计、文档和默认界面，一次装齐。

description.en: Puts a named-user login in front of the DSH Web GUI: Better Auth username/email plus password, with the SPA entry and every API request gated until a valid session exists.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 界面加上实名登录：用 Better Auth 做用户名/邮箱加密码认证，未登录时 SPA 入口和所有 API 请求一律拦下。

description.en: Keeps a long-lived WebSocket link from DSH to a CMS server: dispatches server commands to locally registered actions, queues and replays events while offline, and ships a connection-status and API-key panel.
description.zh: 让 DSH 与 CMS 服务端保持长连接：把服务端指令派发到本机已注册的动作，断线时排队、恢复后重放事件，附带连接状态与 API Key 配置面板。

description.en: Forks a session with explicit options: choose the agent preset and/or provider model for the new branch, so several approaches can run side by side.
description.zh: 带选项地分叉会话：为新分支指定助手预设和/或模型提供方，方便并行试几种不同做法。
